The complete 4-electrocyclization pathway (characterized by the time evolution of  , and the C -C distance) for a representative trajectory of the AIMS/BOMD simulation. A 2 6 three-step mechanism can be clearly identified: 1) isomerization around  forms A' 2) subsequent rotation of  forms A'' 3) shortening of C -C distance leads to B. In the first 1.6ps, the molecule 2 6 exists in the A configuration, where both  and  are approximately 180° and the C -C distance 2 6 oscillates around 4.8Å. Upon relaxation through the S /S CI at ~1.6ps,  begins to twist 90° 1 0 resulting in a shortening of the C -C distance by 0.5Å and the formation of A'. At approximately 2 6 2.2ps, the  angle begins to twist leading to the formation of A''. Once A'' is formed at ~2.6ps, the C -C distance shortens to ~1.55Å, providing an optimal arrangement for the carbon-carbon bond 2 6 formation leading to the closed cyclopentanone form B. 25 LLNL-JRNL-822958 Figure S4.
